title: Day-Count Convention for Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing Monthly Interest
content:
**Convention.** How the annual rate is applied to a Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing account whose plan carries no promotion follows the timing of the posting: interest posted more than the late-posting count of 35 days after the previous monthly-interest entry, or after the funded date where there is none, is figured day by day as the balance times the annual rate times those days over 365; on an account funded before 1 January 2023 whose interest is posted within that count, it is figured day by day as the balance times the annual rate times the days since the previous monthly-interest entry, or since the funded date where there is none, over 360; on every other account it is the balance times one twelfth of the annual rate. Only the interest is rounded to the cent; it goes to the nearest cent, and an exact half cent rounds up.

The days are calendar days from the posting date of the previous monthly-interest entry on the account — or from the funded date where the account has no monthly-interest entry yet — to the day the interest is posted. The same count of days is compared with the late-posting count and used in the 365-day and the 360-day figures.

## Convention table

| Days since the previous monthly-interest entry (or the funded date) | Funded before 1 January 2023 | Interest |
|---|---|---|
| More than 35 | Either | Balance times annual rate times the days, over 365 |
| 35 or fewer | Yes | Balance times annual rate times the days, over 360 |
| 35 or fewer | No | Balance times one twelfth of the annual rate |

## Boundary cases

- 35 days: within the count; 36 days: more than the count, figured over 365.
- An account funded on 31 December 2022 was funded before 1 January 2023; one funded on 1 January 2023 was not.

## Worked examples (hypothetical figures)

Balance 8000.00, annual rate 9.99%:

| Case | Interest |
|---|---|
| 40 days, any funded date | 8000.00 times 9.99% times 40 over 365: 87.5835, so 87.58 |
| 31 days, funded in 2021 | 8000.00 times 9.99% times 31 over 360: 68.82 |
| 31 days, funded in 2024 | 8000.00 times one twelfth of 9.99%: 66.60 |
